text: A pelican sits on the saddle with its feet on the pedals and the whole bicycle in view; the body dips with each stroke and the wheels roll beneath it.
A pelican perched forward on the handlebars, feet on the pedals and bill ahead of the front wheel; the bird leans into each turn while the wheels spin under it.
A pelican low over a light racer with drop bars and a thin frame, cranks turning quickly; the same seat and pedal contacts on a lighter machine.
A pelican upright on a cargo bike with a crate over the front wheel, pedaling slowly; the heavier machine gives the bob a smaller, steadier dip.
A pelican sitting upright on a townie bicycle with a wicker basket on the bars and mudguards over both wheels, pedaling at an easy pace; the wheels and cranks turn at a gentle rate.
